money_precision: BRL cents; no authoritative binary floating point

rounding.rule: Keep decimal/rational precision through intermediate steps and round only the final monetary result of each calculation to the nearest cent.

date_interval_convention.termination_effective_date: First calendar date on which services are no longer owed/rendered. The previous calendar date is the last service day.
date_interval_convention.fidelity_end_exclusive: Calendar anniversary boundary obtained from service_start_date plus fidelity_months. Derive the boundary directly from the original service_start_date; when the original day does not exist in the target month, clamp to the last valid day of that target month. Do not chain month additions in a way that drifts the original day-of-month anchor.

rules.name: nominal_fidelity_value
rules.notes: Reference nominal value; payment dates do not define service consumption.

rules.name: partial_service_value
rules.notes: Count calendar service dates. Use CR-005; round only the final result to cents.

rules.name: remaining_fidelity_balance
rules.formula: Let fidelity_end_exclusive = anchored_add_calendar_months(service_start_date, fidelity_months). Let remaining interval = [termination_effective_date, fidelity_end_exclusive). If termination_effective_date >= fidelity_end_exclusive, balance = 0. Otherwise split the remaining interval by calendar month. For each month M: monthly_slice = current_monthly_fee_brl / actual_calendar_days_in(M) * number_of_calendar_dates_of_remaining_interval_inside(M). remaining_fidelity_balance = sum(monthly_slice for all M), rounded HALF_UP only at the final cent.
rules.notes: termination_effective_date is the first day without service. Do not subtract amounts already paid and do not infer service consumption from invoice/payment history. The calendar-month proportionality convention is deliberate; therefore the remaining balance at an arbitrary boundary is a service-time valuation and need not be reconstructed from amounts paid.

rules.name: early_termination_fidelity_fine
rules.notes: Use CR-007 as base; round final fine HALF_UP to cents.

rules.name: late_payment_fine
rules.notes: Base is the outstanding overdue principal, excluding the late fine itself, interest and monetary correction.

rules.name: late_interest
rules.notes: Simple, non-capitalized interest. A commercial month is fixed at 30 days solely for this pro-rata interest convention. due_date itself has days_overdue = 0; the following calendar day has days_overdue = 1. days_overdue = max(0, calendar-day difference between calculation_date and due_date). Base is outstanding overdue principal after any payments already allocated to principal, excluding late fine, prior interest and IPCA correction. Round only the final interest amount HALF_UP to cents.

rules.name: renewal_creatives_quantity
rules.formula: same as immediately preceding contractual period unless expressly amended
